firmware.title: Commodore 64
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, DnCraptor
firmware.description: A Commodore 64 (PAL) on Frodo4 with SID sound over I2S or PWM. Loads D64 and D81 disk images from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard, NES/SNES/USB pad. F9: swap port, F10: disks, F11: RESTORE.
